project.description: Deploys wildfly-host containers (Gateway, Operations Service, HPDS Query Service, PSAMA, Dictionary, Visualization) sequentially via a single SSM command to avoid systemd D-Bus race conditions, then waits for Spring Boot startup on all enabled containers in parallel.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_ROLLOUT
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Set only by the combined pipeline after validating the banner release tuple.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_ROLLOUT_TUPLE_SHA256
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Canonical digest emitted by the banner rollout validator.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_ROLLOUT_DEPLOYMENT
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Deployment whose exact tuple was validated by the combined pipeline.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_ROLLOUT_RUN_ID
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Exact combined-pipeline run that built the selected backend artifacts.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_ROLLBACK
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Use for attested backend or PSAMA rollback stages.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_ROLLBACK_ATTESTATION_JSON
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Machine-checkable rollback state. Do not include secrets.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
if [[ "${BANNER_ROLLOUT:-false}" == "true" && "${BANNER_ROLLBACK:-false}" == "true" ]]; then echo "ERROR: forward rollout and rollback modes are mutually exclusive." >&2 exit 2 fi if [[ "${BANNER_ROLLBACK:-false}" == "true" ]]; then if [[ -z "${BANNER_ROLLBACK_ATTESTATION_JSON:-}" ]]; then echo "ERROR: banner rollback requires an operator attestation." >&2 exit 2 fi if [[ "${DEPLOY_OPERATIONS:-false}" == "true" && "${DEPLOY_GATEWAY:-false}" == "true" && "${DEPLOY_PSAMA:-false}" != "true" ]]; then required_rollback_stage=BACKEND_ALLOWED elif [[ "${DEPLOY_OPERATIONS:-false}" != "true" && "${DEPLOY_GATEWAY:-false}" != "true" && "${DEPLOY_PSAMA:-false}" == "true" ]]; then required_rollback_stage=PSAMA_ALLOWED else echo "ERROR: rollback must deploy Operations and Gateway together, or recreate PSAMA alone afterward." >&2 exit 2 fi rollback_attestation=$(mktemp) trap 'rm -f "${rollback_attestation}"' EXIT printf '%s' "${BANNER_ROLLBACK_ATTESTATION_JSON}" > "${rollback_attestation}" python3 "${JENKINS_HOME}/banner-rollout/validate-banner-rollout.py" \ --rollback-attestation "${rollback_attestation}" \ --jenkins-source-commit "${JENKINS_SOURCE_COMMIT}" \ --controller-deployment "${BANNER_CONTROLLER_DEPLOYMENT}" \ --target-stack "${TARGET_STACK}" \ --required-rollback-stage "${required_rollback_stage}" fi
if [[ "${BANNER_ROLLOUT:-false}" == "true" ]]; then if [[ -z "${BANNER_ROLLOUT_RUN_ID:-}" ]]; then echo "ERROR: banner rollout requires its combined-pipeline run identity." >&2 exit 2 fi if [[ "${DEPLOY_OPERATIONS:-false}" != "true" || "${DEPLOY_PSAMA:-false}" != "true" || "${DEPLOY_GATEWAY:-false}" != "true" ]]; then echo "ERROR: banner rollout requires Operations, PSAMA, and Gateway in one backend deployment." >&2 exit 2 fi python3 "${JENKINS_HOME}/banner-rollout/validate-banner-rollout.py" \ --deployment "${BANNER_ROLLOUT_DEPLOYMENT}" \ --tuple-sha256 "${BANNER_ROLLOUT_TUPLE_SHA256}" \ --jenkins-source-commit "${JENKINS_SOURCE_COMMIT}" fi
# ----------------------------- # Load shared bash functions # ----------------------------- source_scripts_folder="${JENKINS_HOME}/workspace/Bash_Functions/" echo "Loading bash functions from: ${source_scripts_folder}" ls -la "${source_scripts_folder}"
shopt -s nullglob for script_file in "${source_scripts_folder}"*.sh; do chmod +x "${script_file}" || true if [[ -f "${script_file}" && -x "${script_file}" ]]; then echo "sourcing ${script_file}" # shellcheck source=/dev/null source "${script_file}" fi done shopt -u nullglob
# Fail fast if the core functions weren't loaded for fn in assume_role wait_for_command wait_for_spring_boot_ssm_logs reset_role; do if ! command -v "${fn}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: required function '${fn}' is not loaded from ${source_scripts_folder}" >&2 exit 1 fi done
: "${TARGET_STACK:?TARGET_STACK is required}" : "${S3_BUCKET_NAME:?S3_BUCKET_NAME is required}"
artifact_prefix="${TARGET_STACK}/containers" expected_backend_commit=$(python3 "${JENKINS_HOME}/banner-rollout/validate-banner-rollout.py" --component-commit backend) if [[ "${BANNER_ROLLBACK:-false}" == "true" ]]; then artifact_prefix=$(jq -r '.artifactPrefix' "${rollback_attestation}") expected_backend_commit=$(jq -r '.artifacts.backendCommit' "${rollback_attestation}") elif [[ "${BANNER_ROLLOUT:-false}" == "true" ]]; then [[ "${BANNER_ROLLOUT_RUN_ID}" =~ ^combined-[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo "ERROR: invalid banner rollout run identity." >&2; exit 2; } artifact_prefix="${TARGET_STACK}/banner-rollout/${BANNER_ROLLOUT_RUN_ID}/containers" fi
# Default optional parameters DATASET_S3_OBJECT_KEY="${DATASET_S3_OBJECT_KEY:-}" ENABLE_DEBUG="${ENABLE_DEBUG:-false}" SPRING_PROFILE="${SPRING_PROFILE:-prod}"
assume_role
banner_backend_seen=false for artifact in \ "${DEPLOY_OPERATIONS}:pic-sure-operations-service.tar.gz" \ "${DEPLOY_PSAMA}:psama.tar.gz" \ "${DEPLOY_GATEWAY}:pic-sure-gateway.tar.gz" \ "${DEPLOY_QUERY}:pic-sure-hpds-query-service.tar.gz"; do selected="${artifact%%:*}" object_name="${artifact#*:}" if [[ "${selected}" != "true" ]]; then continue fi artifact_commit=$(aws s3api head-object \ --bucket "${S3_BUCKET_NAME}" \ --key "${artifact_prefix}/${object_name}" \ --query 'Metadata."git-commit"' \ --output text) if [[ "${artifact_commit}" == "${expected_backend_commit}" ]]; then banner_backend_seen=true elif [[ "${BANNER_ROLLOUT:-false}" == "true" ]]; then echo "ERROR: ${object_name} does not match the reviewed banner backend commit." >&2 exit 2 fi done if [[ "${banner_backend_seen}" == "true" && "${BANNER_ROLLOUT:-false}" != "true" ]]; then echo "ERROR: reviewed banner backend artifacts require the combined banner pipeline." >&2 exit 2 fi
# ----------------------------- # Download terraform state # ----------------------------- echo "Download terraform.tfstate file for ${TARGET_STACK} stack" aws s3 cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET_NAME}/deployment_state_metadata/${TARGET_STACK}/terraform.tfstate" "terraform.tfstate"
# ----------------------------- # Extract Wildfly EC2 instance ID # ----------------------------- echo "Extract WildFly instance ID for ${TARGET_STACK} stack" wildfly_instance_id="$(jq -r '.outputs["wildfly-ec2-id"].value // empty' terraform.tfstate)"
if [[ -z "${wildfly_instance_id}" ]]; then echo "ERROR: Could not extract wildfly_instance_id from terraform.tfstate" >&2 exit 1 fi
echo "WildFly Instance ID: ${wildfly_instance_id}"
# ----------------------------- # Build remote command flags # ----------------------------- deploy_flags="" if [[ "${DEPLOY_GATEWAY}" == "true" ]]; then deploy_flags="${deploy_flags} --deploy_gateway" fi if [[ "${DEPLOY_OPERATIONS}" == "true" ]]; then deploy_flags="${deploy_flags} --deploy_operations" fi if [[ "${DEPLOY_QUERY}" == "true" ]]; then deploy_flags="${deploy_flags} --deploy_query" fi if [[ "${DEPLOY_PSAMA}" == "true" ]]; then deploy_flags="${deploy_flags} --deploy_psama" fi if [[ "${DEPLOY_DICTIONARY}" == "true" ]]; then deploy_flags="${deploy_flags} --deploy_dictionary" fi if [[ "${DEPLOY_VISUALIZATION}" == "true" ]]; then deploy_flags="${deploy_flags} --deploy_visualization" fi
remote_cmd=$( cat <<EOF sudo /opt/picsure/deploy-wildfly-stack.sh \ ${deploy_flags} \ --stack_s3_bucket "${S3_BUCKET_NAME}" \ --target_stack "${TARGET_STACK}" \ --artifact_prefix "${artifact_prefix}" \ --dataset_s3_object_key "${DATASET_S3_OBJECT_KEY}" \ --enable_debug "${ENABLE_DEBUG}" \ --spring_profile "${SPRING_PROFILE}" EOF )
echo "${remote_cmd}"
remote_cmd_json="$(jq -n --arg cmd "${remote_cmd}" '{commands: [$cmd]}')"
# ----------------------------- # Send single SSM command # ----------------------------- command_id="$( aws ssm send-command \ --instance-ids "${wildfly_instance_id}" \ --document-name "AWS-RunShellScript" \ --comment "Deploy PIC-SURE Stack (Gateway+Operations+Query+PSAMA+Dictionary+Visualization)" \ --parameters "${remote_cmd_json}" \ --timeout-seconds 600 \ --query "Command.CommandId" \ --output text )"
wait_for_command "${command_id}" "${wildfly_instance_id}"
# ----------------------------- # Wait for Spring Boot startup on all enabled containers (in parallel) # ----------------------------- pids=()
if [[ "${DEPLOY_GATEWAY}" == "true" ]]; then wait_for_spring_boot_ssm_logs "${wildfly_instance_id}" "gateway" & pids+=($!) fi
if [[ "${DEPLOY_OPERATIONS}" == "true" ]]; then wait_for_spring_boot_ssm_logs "${wildfly_instance_id}" "pic-sure-operations-service" & pids+=($!) fi
if [[ "${DEPLOY_QUERY}" == "true" ]]; then wait_for_spring_boot_ssm_logs "${wildfly_instance_id}" "pic-sure-hpds-query-service" & pids+=($!) fi
if [[ "${DEPLOY_PSAMA}" == "true" ]]; then wait_for_spring_boot_ssm_logs "${wildfly_instance_id}" "psama" & pids+=($!) fi
if [[ "${DEPLOY_DICTIONARY}" == "true" ]]; then wait_for_spring_boot_ssm_logs "${wildfly_instance_id}" "dictionary-api" & pids+=($!) fi
if [[ "${DEPLOY_VISUALIZATION}" == "true" ]]; then wait_for_spring_boot_ssm_logs "${wildfly_instance_id}" "visualization" & pids+=($!) fi
failed=false for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do if ! wait "${pid}"; then failed=true fi done
if [[ "${failed}" == "true" ]]; then echo "ERROR: One or more Spring Boot applications failed to start." exit 1 fi
if [[ "${BANNER_ROLLOUT:-false}" == "true" ]]; then # The command substitution runs on the target host through SSM. # shellcheck disable=SC2016 health_command='test "$(curl --fail --silent --show-error http://localhost:8080/system/status)" = "RUNNING"' health_command_json=$(jq -n --arg cmd "${health_command}" '{commands: [$cmd]}') health_command_id=$(aws ssm send-command \ --instance-ids "${wildfly_instance_id}" \ --document-name "AWS-RunShellScript" \ --comment "Verify Gateway and downstream aggregate health" \ --parameters "${health_command_json}" \ --timeout-seconds 60 \ --query "Command.CommandId" \ --output text) if ! (wait_for_command "${health_command_id}" "${wildfly_instance_id}"); then aws ssm get-command-invocation \ --command-id "${health_command_id}" \ --instance-id "${wildfly_instance_id}" \ --query '{Status:Status,StandardOutputContent:StandardOutputContent,StandardErrorContent:StandardErrorContent}' \ --output json >&2 || true exit 1 fi fi
echo "All wildfly-host containers started successfully."
reset_role
